fragen.frage: Which learning goal is most useful?
optionen: I want to be better at everything somehow.
I will learn ten travel words by Friday and use them in three sentences.
I hope English becomes easy on its own.
I will only study when I feel stressed.
fragen.erklaerung: Ein gutes Ziel ist konkret, realistisch und überprüfbar.

fragen.frage: Why are short, regular practice sessions often better than one very long session?
optionen: Because spaced practice helps memory over time.
Because long sessions are never allowed.
Because short sessions remove all mistakes immediately.
Because regular practice only works for grammar.
fragen.erklaerung: Verteiltes Lernen unterstützt die langfristige Speicherung.

fragen.frage: You feel nervous before speaking. What is a good plan?
optionen: Avoid speaking tasks completely.
Prepare a few key phrases and practise with a partner.
Memorise the whole dictionary.
Only use German during the activity.
fragen.erklaerung: Konkrete Vorbereitung und Übung senken Unsicherheit.

fragen.frage: What belongs in a learning journal or reflection note?
optionen: Only the date
What worked well and what is still difficult
Only your best marks
A list of words you already know perfectly
fragen.erklaerung: Reflexion hilft, Fortschritte und nächste Schritte sichtbar zu machen.

fragen.frage: Why is it useful to look at your mistakes after a test or task?
optionen: To spot patterns and improve specific areas
To punish yourself for every error
To prove that learning does not work
To avoid asking questions next time
fragen.erklaerung: Fehleranalyse zeigt, woran man gezielt weiterarbeiten kann.

fragen.frage: What is a sensible revision plan before a vocabulary quiz next week?
optionen: Study everything once very late at night.
Review the words in several short sessions during the week.
Wait until the teacher repeats them.
Only look at the easiest words.
fragen.erklaerung: Mehrere kurze Wiederholungen sind meist wirksamer als einmaliges Pauken.

fragen.frage: After a listening task, what is worth reflecting on?
optionen: Which strategy helped you understand the main idea
Only how long the audio was
Whether your neighbour finished first
How many times the teacher smiled
fragen.erklaerung: Wer wirksame Strategien erkennt, kann sie gezielter wieder einsetzen.

fragen.frage: Why do different tasks need different learning strategies?
optionen: Because reading, listening and speaking place different demands on learners
Because one strategy always works for absolutely everything
Because strategies only matter in tests
Because planning is less useful than luck
fragen.erklaerung: Je nach Aufgabe helfen unterschiedliche Vorgehensweisen.
